item.title: Spain Sends Frigate to Cyprus Which Will Arrive Before Royal Navy Destroyer
item.description: The Spanish Ministry of Defence has announced that its advanced frigate the Cristóbal Colón will sail to Cyprus to defend the island. It is set to get there at roughly the same time HMS Dragon leaves port in Britain… The frigate is currently sailing with the French aircraft carrier the Charles de Gaulle for training…
